Transaction outside of Amazon.in where Amazon Pay is a payment option.

Recharges: Mobile, DTH, Google Play, FastTag, Metro

Investments & Insurance

Donations

The Luxe Gift Card is issued by Pine Labs Limited (formerly Pine Labs Private Limited) and is valid for 12 months from the date of purchase.

The Luxe Gift Card is not redeemable at airport stores.

Alternatively, activation can be done via the portal: https://bit.ly/4072sdb

Comes with lifetime validity and can be redeemed at an Xbox console by logging in with your Microsoft account.
Game catalog varies over time, by region, and by device
Requires Windows 10/11 (with updates); excludes S Mode and ARM devices.
See xbox.com/pcgamepass and ea.com/ea-play/terms and ea.com/ea-play for details
Requires: Download(s), apps, significant storage, broadband (fees may apply), and a Microsoft account.

From that menu, select Redeem.
Enter the 25-character code, and then follow the prompts. Don’t worry about hyphens, the system takes care of those for you.

yatra-gift-card.important_instructions_raw:
The E-Gift Voucher (EGV) can be redeemed only on www.yatra.com
and is valid for bookings of Domestic & International Flights, Domestic Hotels, Domestic Buses, and Domestic/International Holiday Packages.
For online redemption (Flights / Hotels / Buses), select your preferred service and proceed to the payment page. Choose “Gift Voucher” as the payment mode, enter the 16-digit EGV/Card number and 6-digit PIN, click on “Redeem Gift Card,” and pay the balance amount, if any, using other available payment methods. In case of a transaction failure, the deducted amount will be automatically refunded back to the same EGV.
Holiday packages (Domestic & International) can be redeemed offline only by sending a redemption request via email to coepromoteam@yatra.com.
The EGV supports partial and multiple redemptions until the balance is fully utilized within the validity period. However, only one voucher can be used per booking, and multiple vouchers cannot be clubbed in a single transaction.
Any applicable convenience fee, processing fee, excess tour cost, or government taxes must be paid separately if the booking value exceeds the voucher amount.
Lost or stolen vouchers will not be replaced or compensated. The EGV cannot be combined with any other discount, cashback, or promotional offer, and no additional discount beyond the voucher value will be applicable. Booking confirmation is subject to availability and governed by Yatra’s standard booking terms. Expired vouchers cannot be revalidated, and no cash or balance amount will be provided in exchange for the EGV.
If a booking made using the EGV is cancelled within the validity period, the refundable amount will be credited back to the same voucher. If the voucher has expired at the time of cancellation, no refund will be processed.
Customers can check their voucher balance online at https://yatra.woohoo.in/en-in/CheckBalance.
All disputes related to the EGV shall be subject to the jurisdiction of courts in Gurgaon, Haryana. This voucher is meant for individual use only, and usage by travel agents may result in cancellation without refund.

zoom-car-gift-card.important_instructions_raw:
Comes with 6 months validity and will be accepted only online on the Zoomcar mobile application.
This is a one-time use Gift card. Multiple Gift cards can be added to a customer’s account as ZCash, and the balance can be used partially or fully for multiple transactions.
The Gift card can be used for the purchase of ZCash, which is credited to the Customer’s Zoomcar ZCash wallet upon redemption. A single ZCash shall be equivalent to INR 1 (One Rupee).
The Gift card can be clubbed with the existing offers.
No returns and no refunds on Gift cards, E-Gift cards and E-Gift vouchers.
how_to_redeem_steps: Open the zoomcar App, go to zoom cash at the top right corner and click on claim a gift card.
In select gift partner choose Gyftr enter the voucher code click add and then click continue.
The amount will be added to zoom cash, multiple vouchers can be added and then click on book a trip.
